verdict.rationale: Bugbot is a SaaS code-review service, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. The evidence never mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes are machine-readable documentation, a related but different feature, and do not count as an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
